description: Reads the relative protocols of endless rotary knobs on a MIDI controller and turns each twist of a knob into triggers.

outputs.text: Fires a trigger each time the MIDI control assigned to this jack is turned up.
Fires a trigger each time the MIDI control assigned to this jack is turned down.

notes: nothing is produced until a MIDI device is picked on the display, the protocol matching the controller is chosen, and each CC slot has learned a control by being clicked and the knob turned.
menu: Polyphonic output — sends all sixteen channels on the first increment and decrement jacks instead of using eight jacks for each.
Protocol — Beatstep Relative #1, Beatstep Relative #2, NI Komplete Kontrol Relative, Behringer X-TOUCH Relative1 and Relative2, Akai MPD218 INC/DEC 2, or Hercules DJControl Starlight.
